Hi all, hope everyone is doing well during Quiet Week. Looking for a short break from your studies? There is a short special seminar presented by the Office of the Executive Vice President for Research and Partnerships and The Center for Education and Research in Information Assurance and Security (CERIAS) on Friday, December 9. A virtual attendance option has also been included Friday, December 9, 2022 WALC 3122 11:30 am – 12:30 pm In-person or virtually via Zoom Join us for a seminar featuring T. Charles Clancy, PhD, Senior Vice President at MITRE Pizza will be served in person. RSVP at this link<https://purdue.ca1.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_8uIbXltoi6NjHym>. Title: Emerging Security Needs for Web3 Abstract: Decentralized technologies are an exciting approach for future Internet services and architectures. For the past few years, decentralized finance (DeFi) systems that have proliferated have been subjected to significant exploitation. This talk will walk through the emerging tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) for exploiting blockchain infrastructure and smart contracts, and their impact on DeFi services. We will then explore lines of research necessary to fortify infrastructure to create a secure and resilient footing for broader decentralized web3 services. Speaker: T. Charles Clancy, PhD Bio: Charles Clancy is a Senior Vice President at MITRE where he leads science, technology, and engineering for the non-profit research institution. Previously he served as the Bradley Distinguished Professor of Cybersecurity in the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering at Virginia Tech, where he led the university’s security-focused research programs. He started his career as a researcher at the National Security Agency. Clancy is a Fellow of the IEEE for “technical leadership of secure and wireless communications”. He received his PhD in CS from UMD, MS in EE from UIUC, and BS in CompE from Rose-Hulman. Hope to see some of you there!

Hi all, BoilerBlockchain has been invited by the Purdue Startup Expo to meet with Beeple - a Purdue alum that is one of the top 3 currently living visual artists in the world. An overview on "Beeple": Beeple, whose real name is Mike Winkelmann, is a digital artist who rose to fame in 2021 after a record-breaking NFT sale of his artwork for **$69 million**. He is known for creating stunning digital art pieces that often feature surreal and dystopian themes. He has been creating and sharing these pieces online every day for over a decade, amassing a large following on social media platforms such as Instagram and Twitter. One of Beeple's most notable works is "Everydays: The First 5000 Days," a collage of his daily digital art pieces that was sold as an NFT (non-fungible token) at Christie's auction house in March 2021. The sale made Beeple **one of the highest-paid living artists in the world, and brought NFTs into the mainstream art world.** Beeple's digital art is not only visually stunning, but also often carries a powerful social commentary on issues such as politics, society, and technology. His work has been exhibited in galleries and museums around the world, and he has collaborated with major brands such as **Nike, Louis Vuitton, and Apple.** https://www.beeple-crap.com/ https://www.instagram.com/beeple_crap/?hl=en
